title: SLO root-cause classifier and degradation signature canvas
creator: Marina Gomez
description: Create a heuristic + ML-assisted classifier and a Grafana canvas that maps SLO breaches to a concise degradation signature (root-cause class) to speed incident TTR. Focus on token-level latency SLIs, golden-signal derivatives, and multi-region failover fingerprints (admit-score, KV hit-rate, decode-time, queue-depth, shard-eviction). The output will power a dashboard and a runbook for automated remediation suggestions and escalation hints.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard canvas shows top-3 degradation signatures for the past 24h for any selected route or tenant
Classifier achieves >70% precision for top-3 classes on synthetic and historical incidents (evaluation dataset)
Token-level SLI traces (p50/p95/p99) correlated with classifier labels and displayed in the canvas
Runbook link and suggested mitigation steps surface for each signature in the canvas
Pipeline instrumentation changes land and do not increase emission cost by >10%
plan: 1) Define signature taxonomy and golden-signal derivations. 2) Instrument additional metadata (admit_score, kv_hit, decode_ms, seq_len, shard_id). 3) Build offline classifier prototype (rule-based + light XGBoost on engineered features). 4) Create Grafana canvas with heatmaps and signature overlays. 5) Validate on two recent incidents and synth traffic. 6) Ship runbook links and a canary rollout on staging then prod.
decisions: Use a hybrid approach: deterministic rules for high-confidence mapping (e.g., kv_hit==0 & p99_decode>threshold -> 'cold-KV-miss') with ML to disambiguate overlapping patterns
Emit new fields at ingress (admit_score, route_bucket, seq_len_bucket) to avoid downstream join costs
Prioritize per-route canvases first (most customer-impact) before tenant-wide aggregation
blockers: Telemetry schema change requires backwards-compatible update to the sampling agent (infra approval, ETA 2026-03-05)
Need access to historical per-token KV hit traces for training — storage retention query pending (observability team)
Grafana panel quota on our hosted Grafana instance needs increase for dense heatmaps

notes: Aim is not to replace human triage but to cut first-diagnosis time by surfacing a ranked, evidence-backed hypothesis. We'll monitor precision and operator trust metrics post-launch. If emission cost grows beyond 10%, we'll move heavy feature joins to offline scoring and retain only high-signal fields online.
